QuestInfo.name: [Maple Castle] A Tall Order
QuestInfo.0: Cygnus has a favor to ask you. She seems pretty nervous about it...
QuestInfo.1: Ahh...she was nervous because she just asked you to clean the ENTIRE ballroom. Good thing you love helping so much! Get to it.
QuestInfo.2: Somehow, you managed to clean that whole room yourself, and found a few #i3994656##t3994656# things, too. Someone must REALLY hate studying.

0.0: #b#h0##n#k! I'm so glad you're here. Um... You see... The ballroom is where all the really fun stuff is going to happen, but... Oh, it's just so dirty!\r\nCould I please ask you, to, well...?

yes.0: Oh, yes! Thank you! You may find #buseful items#k when you're cleaning, too, so it'll be good for you! Let me know if you DO find anything #buseful#k.
yes.1: Just take the door next to me #bto get to the ballroom#k. I'll be waiting for you here.

I've heard legends of this school, but seeing these test results really makes it real. Er... I will take care of these...embarrassing test sheets. Hey, don't look at the name! Stop stop stop! STOP!
